neighbours.label: the token ' baby' (infant), especially as possessor or modifier ('your baby's skin', 'baby boy')
fire: To protect your baby's skin, use a gentle cream after the bath.
The pediatrician checked our newborn baby's hearing before we left.
This soft blanket keeps your baby warm during the night.
Dress your little baby girl in this cotton romper for summer.
Most parents worry when their baby's sleep pattern changes.
The seat has a cushion to ensure the baby stays comfortable.
Rashes can appear on a baby's cheeks in the first weeks.
Hold your baby close while feeding to help her relax.
quiet: To protect your own skin, use a gentle cream after the bath.
The doctor checked our elderly father's hearing before we left.
This soft blanket keeps your dog warm during the night.
Dress your little niece in this cotton dress for summer.
Most parents worry when their teenager's sleep pattern changes.
The seat has a cushion to ensure the driver stays comfortable.
Rashes can appear on a patient's cheeks in the first weeks.
Hold your kitten close while feeding to help her relax.

notes: Probe: 'your baby is warm at night' peaked off ' baby' (0.24); top examples are 'your baby's ...'.
